### 💡 Your phone works. What about the integration?

FRITZ!Box Phone is a hobby project and stays free. There are three ways to help:

- ⭐ **Star it on GitHub**: it makes the project easier to find
- 🐞 **Report a bug or an idea**: as an [issue](https://github.com/bertel2020/HA-fritzbox_phone/issues/new)
- ☕ **Support the developer**: [Buy Me a Coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/bertel2020) · [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/bertel2020) · [PayPal](https://paypal.me/RobertoMartins)

🇬🇧 Changelog in English: [CHANGELOG.en.md](https://github.com/bertel2020/HA-fritzbox_phone/blob/main/CHANGELOG.en.md)
